## About
The Auto Club is a detailing and car electronics shop on Old Georges Rd in North Brunswick, NJ. We handle custom detailing, paintless dent repair, window tinting, clear bra protection, security alarms, remote starters and audio systems.
We work on all types of transportation: everyday cars, exotics and classics, sport bikes and choppers, campers, tractor trailers, boats and wave runners. Customers have given us a 4.3 rating on Google from 58 reviews, and a lot of them mention Dave by name.

## Services
- Custom detailing: Detailing for cars, trucks, bikes and more. Stop by or get in touch to talk about what your vehicle needs.
- Paintless dent repair: Our techs work dings and dents out without the costs a body shop charges.
- Security alarms and remote start: We install Viper security and remote start systems.
- Custom audio systems: Custom audio, car stereos and head units, plus Bluetooth. Come talk with one of our audio experts.
- Invisible car bra: A clear bra helps guard your car, truck, SUV or motorcycle from rocks, debris, bug acids and weathering.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on motorcycles?
A: Yes. We detail sport bikes and choppers and offer full and partial wraps.

Q: What remote start brand do you install?
A: We install Viper security and remote start systems.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No. We're open Monday through Saturday and closed on Sunday.
